_doc: Weekly Instagram posting plan (owner's rule, Jul 28 2026).
People dream on weekends and buy on weekdays, so we sell early in the week
and inspire late. This file is the ONLY place the plan lives. Retune it
after four weeks against real analytics; no code change needed.
A 'shape' describes the TRIP we want the board to lean toward that day:
nights     [min, max] round trip length in nights
depart_in  [min, max] days from today the outbound leg may leave
It is a PREFERENCE, never a filter that costs a real deal. fetch_fares.py
picks a route's shape-matching fare when that fare still clears the 12%
bar, and otherwise falls back to the route's cheapest fare in the wide
window. The shape can change WHICH honest deal is shown. It can never
lower the bar, pad the board, or drop a route that had a genuine deal.

week.angle: A full week away, round trip, verified this morning.

weekend.angle: Long weekend shaped. Out and back before you burn real vacation days.

urgent.angle: These leave inside three weeks. Short window, short trip, real prices.

friday.angle: Expedia's 2026 Air Hacks Report puts Friday as the cheapest day of the week to book a flight, about 3% under Sunday, and the cheapest day to fly overall, up to 8% under a Sunday departure. Worth knowing: for US domestic routes specifically that report still has Tuesday as the cheapest day to actually fly, roughly 14% under Sunday.

twoweek.angle: The big one. Honeymoon, anniversary, the trip you keep putting off.

0.note: Monday. Peak booking day. The money post.

4.note: Friday. Cheapest day to book and fly, per Expedia 2026.

5.note: Saturday. PLAN: city guide carousel, build trust, do not sell. The guide renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board. Flip content to guide once it does.

6.note: Sunday. PLAN: inspiration plus a Monday teaser. Renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board.

alternating._doc: Every other Sunday the two week post replaces the usual Sunday content. Twice a month max, on purpose, so it stays special. Parity is on the ISO week number.

content_mix_target._doc: Not enforced by code. Written down so drift is visible when you review analytics.
